headline: Executive order signed in April 2023 that updates how the federal government reviews new regulations before they take effect.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order changes the process federal agencies and the White House use to review proposed regulations. It aims to update, or modernize, those review rules. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would follow an updated process when preparing and submitting new rules for review.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses, groups, and members of the public affected by federal rules
who_it_affects.how: Changes to the review process could shape how new regulations are studied and approved before they apply to them.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 6, 2023; no separate effective date was provided.
